description: This file is a shell script used for testing various aspects of Git's handling of line endings, particularly focusing on CRLF and LF conversions, gitattributes settings, and how files are processed during commits and checkouts. It contains functions for creating test files, setting attributes, performing commits, and validating expected outcomes related to line ending normalization and binary contents.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming their contents to handle CR and NUL characters, verifies they are identical.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares the contents of a file and a reference after translating line endings and replacing specific patterns.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for testing line ending normalization.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Sets up a series of test files with various line ending configurations and attributes.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks the warning messages generated during test operations for expected content.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs commit operations with specific attributes and verifies the associated warnings.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up and commits files with various attributes and checks warning messages.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Commits files with mixed line endings and verifies warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Translates line ending configurations to human-readable symbols.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Returns textual representation of git attributes based on line ending configuration.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Verifies that files in the repository match expected line ending configurations.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Verifies files with 'Not Normalized in the Repository' configurations.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Tests checking out files with various attributes and configurations, verifying the resulting file contents.
